question: Which religious groups are included among those who lack knowledge of the supreme state?
premises: Some followers of the Soma doctrine are mentioned
inference: Various religious groups, including Buddhists, Arhats, and Soma-doctrine followers, are among those who do not know this state.
uncertainties: rahantāś is an archaic/variant form for arhats; somasiddhānta-dakṣiṇāḥ reading uncertain
plain_english: Buddhists, Arhats, and any southern followers of the Soma doctrine.
